children: Overview
Austria lighting solutions firm's fiscal Q1 revenue nearly stable, down 0.9% yr/yr
Adjusted EBIT for fiscal Q1 rose, reflecting lower material costs and efficiency measures
Company returned to positive net profit in fiscal Q1, outlook for year confirmed
Outlook
Zumtobel confirms 2026/27 outlook for revenues at prior year level
Company expects 2026/27 adjusted EBIT margin of 3% to 5%
Company sees continued challenging market with subdued economic development in major European countries
Result Drivers
EFFICIENCY MEASURES - Co said ongoing efficiency programme and reduced material costs strengthened profitability
SEGMENT PERFORMANCE - Lighting segment revenue grew slightly, offsetting declines in Components segment
REGIONAL TRENDS - Growth in Northern and Western Europe, Asia & Pacific, and America & MEA partly offset declines in D/A/CH and Southern and Eastern Europe
